print(f'New history name: {new_hist[\"name\"]}')

# Copy the dataset from seed to new history
datasets = gi.histories.show_history(seed_id, contents=True)
for ds in datasets:
    if ds.get('type') == 'dataset' and ds['state'] == 'ok':
        print(f'Copying dataset: {ds[\"name\"]} (ID: {ds[\"id\"]})')
        gi.histories.copy_dataset(new_hist['id'], ds['id'], source='hda')
print('Copy complete')
"
